edits.old: On May 1, 1934, Defendant No. 1 offered to grant leases
edits.new: On March 5, 1934, Defendant No. 1 offered to grant leases
edits.reason: The source text S2c4036b2445a states the offer was made by a letter dated 'the Slat March, 1934' (interpreted as 5th March), not May 1. The draft's date of May 1 contradicts the subsequent acceptance date of April 15, 1934.

edits.old: The attempt to seek compensation or alternative relief failed because the Lime Co. did not strictly adhere to the requirements of Section 15 of the Specific Relief Act, specifically the relinquishment of all claims for deficiency or damages for prior periods [S952f65c826eb, S7093796118f1].
edits.new: The attempt to seek compensation or alternative relief failed because the High Court held that the conditions of Section 15 were not fulfilled, finding that the application dated February 18, 1952, did not show relinquishment of all claims to further performance and right to compensation for deficiency or loss/damage sustained through default [S952f65c826eb], despite the Lime Co.'s assertion in an application that it relinquished claims for periods prior to April 1, 1948 [S7093796118f1].
edits.reason: Source S952f65c826eb specifies the High Court disallowed the claim because the Feb 18, 1952 application did not show relinquishment of *all* claims (including those for the period after April 1, 1948, or generally). Source S7093796118f1 shows the Lime Co. did file an application attempting to relinquish claims for the period *prior* to April 1, 1948. The draft incorrectly implies total failure to adhere/relinquish without distinguishing the specific scope of the relinquishment attempted versus what the court required.

not_changed.reason: The draft correctly attributes the High Court's finding that the agreement was void under Section 20 of the Indian Contract Act due to mutual mistake of fact regarding title to source S4da221281e65. No correction is needed.
The draft accurately reflects Defendant No. 2's plea of protection as a subsequent lessee for valuable consideration based on source S575f63eec68a. No correction is needed.
The draft accurately describes the trial court's framing of issues regarding essential terms and uncertainty based on sources Sea59ce9cf59a and S80dc026f442c. No correction is needed.
